about: Adapter rules for command-line programs (plan 4.1, M5): each command the CLI adapter found (a PowerShell cmdlet or a native tool's sub-command) is a 'Command' node carrying its own input schema and kind; these rules turn it into one typed 'run' action. The kind comes from the program's own metadata (PowerShell verb and ConfirmImpact; a native command's description) and the destructive lexicon still applies on top.
source: doc: Get-Command (PowerShell 5.1) parameter metadata; native help texts parsed by library/cli/help-formats.json
